Core geometric point <^ is catalog-deprecated (prefer <<|) but not DIC-owned dead code; box variant allows touching.
Equality for circles and boxes compares area, not full geometric shape. Temporal, bpchar, numeric and JSONB equality semantics differ by type.
Procedure links, present commutator/negator reciprocal links and index family references checked. No new proven DIC app bug, justified deletion or measured bottleneck.
